sloka: गंग संप्लावयामास यज्ञ वाटम् महत्मनः ।तसया वलेपनम् ज्ञत्व कृद्धो जह्नुः च राघव ॥१-४३-३४॥
transliteration: gaṁga saṁplāvayāmāsa yajña vāṭam mahatmanaḥ ।tasayā valepanam jñatva kṛddho jahnuḥ ca rāghava ॥1-43-34॥

translations.english: Then while Ganga was flowing, it inundated the sacrificial ground of the great sage Jahnu. Jahnu who used to work wonders was performing a sacrifice.
